name: takegraph
description: Agent-native, voice-first video editing with reviewable patches.

scripts.build: pnpm build:view && pnpm build:mcp && cargo build --workspace
scripts.check: pnpm -r check && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm spec:typecheck && pnpm spec:run
